verdict.rationale: Square ships Square AI (Beta), an assistant built into the seller's tools that answers natural-language questions over their own sales and inventory data plus web data, and claims to "handle routine tasks." The documented examples are analysis and insight queries, not delegated actions, and the feature is still in Beta. The MCP server is an external-agent integration and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented examples of the assistant executing tasks or actions (not just answering data questions), detail on scope and limits of delegation, GA status, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Square AI is built into your everyday tools to pull game-changing insights from your data and handle routine tasks to help you get ahead
Skip the report hunting, filter setting, and manual analysis — just ask about your data.
